simple: Source code analysis (SAST) without running the application: finds vulnerabilities and quality defects, including complex ones that span several files and libraries. 22 languages and 250+ frameworks, plus infrastructure-as-code checks. Compliance reports for OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, PCI DSS, DISA STIG, EU CRA, CERT secure coding and MISRA, AUTOSAR, ISO 26262, IEC 61508 and DO-178C functional safety — with TÜV SÜD certification for critical systems (automotive, aviation, rail). Installed in your own data center, including fully air-gapped, or runs as Polaris fAST Static in the cloud. AI triage of findings, pull request scanning, the Code Sight IDE plug-in and an MCP server for developers’ AI assistants. Black Duck is the former Synopsys Software Integrity Group, an independent company since October 2024.
